title: frangula × blumeri
intro: Frangula × blumeri, commonly known as the False Buckthorn, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Rhamnaceae family, resulting from the cross between Frangula alnus and Rhamnus cathartica. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and liver issues, due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving gut health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Frangula × blumeri are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, act as a laxative, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
